name: Fix off-by-one slice bounds in a Python data processor
prompt: In src/processor.py, chunk(items, size) drops the trailing remainder whenever the input does not divide evenly by `size`, and it also loses whole chunks for evenly divisible input. Fix the slice bounds so every item is returned exactly once, in order, in chunks of at most `size` elements. Keep the existing ValueError for a non-positive size. Assertions run `python3 -m unittest test_processor.py`.
